skill.name: meituan-printer
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through configuring Meituan thermal printers, checking LAN connectivity, formatting ESC/POS task slips, and preparing immediate or scheduled print commands.
skill.summary: Manage documented Meituan thermal printer workflows by alias or LAN address.
skill.author: chenyangshu

security_audit.summary: Most hardcoded addresses, Markdown backticks, and entropy alerts are false positives from examples and readable documentation. However, the skill directs command execution and persistent scheduling, and it promotes unpinned software installation. The audited bundle omits every referenced script, preventing verification of runtime safeguards.

remediation.issue: Persistent launchd and Windows scheduled tasks can outlive the application.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, preview every task definition, use scoped names, and provide verified removal steps before creating persistent tasks.

remediation.issue: User-controlled print text is shown inside a shell command template.
remediation.suggestion: Pass arguments as an array without a shell. Validate lengths and characters, and never concatenate user content into command strings.

remediation.issue: Third-party installation instructions are mutable and unverified.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an immutable trusted revision, publish checksums, show the exact commands, and require user approval before installing external software.

remediation.issue: Flask and APScheduler installation uses unpinned package names.
remediation.suggestion: Declare reviewed versions with hashes, install them in an isolated environment, and require confirmation before changing the Python environment.

remediation.issue: Printer checks and print jobs accept arbitrary IP addresses and ports.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict destinations to approved printer addresses and expected ports. Reject loopback, public, metadata, and unrelated internal service targets.

remediation.issue: The audited bundle omits all referenced scripts and web assets.
remediation.suggestion: Include the complete implementation for review, or remove runtime capability claims until the executable files can be audited.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Third-Party Installation Workflow
semantic_findings.description: The README asks an agent to follow mutable SkillHub instructions and install software without a pinned revision, checksum, or reviewed command set.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The installation prompt and external instruction URL are explicit. The remote content was not included, so its integrity cannot be verified.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Unpinned Dependency Installation
semantic_findings.description: The documented launcher automatically installs Flask and APScheduler, while the manual command also omits versions and integrity checks.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly describe dependency installation without pinned versions. The absent launcher prevents verification of additional safeguards.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Internal Network Destinations
semantic_findings.description: The workflow accepts an arbitrary IP and port for connectivity checks and printing without documenting an allowlist or destination validation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly map user-provided addresses into network commands. Missing scripts prevent confirmation of runtime validation.

content.user_title: Print and Schedule Meituan Thermal Jobs
content.value_statement: Store teams need a reliable way to format and route thermal print jobs. This skill documents printer setup, connectivity checks, immediate printing, and scheduled jobs.
actual_capabilities: Guides collection of printer aliases, LAN addresses, ports, types, and remarks.
Documents a connectivity-check command for a selected printer address and port.
Documents immediate print commands using an alias or direct network address.
Defines task-slip formatting with titles, timestamps, separators, Chinese text, and paper cutting.
Describes web administration and daily, weekly, or monthly scheduling workflows.
Provides an example configuration for three local thermal printers.
limitations: The audited bundle omits the referenced Python scripts, web assets, templates, and reference files.
Printing, connectivity checks, and web administration cannot work without the missing implementation.
The workflow expects a trusted local network and a compatible ESC/POS printer with GB18030 support.
System scheduling changes persist beyond the web process and require careful user approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare Daily Kitchen Slips
use_cases.description: Draft and preview shift tasks before sending them to a configured kitchen printer.

use_cases.title: Document Printer Setup
use_cases.description: Organize printer aliases, addresses, ports, types, and connectivity checks for a store network.

use_cases.title: Plan Recurring Print Jobs
use_cases.description: Define daily, weekly, or monthly task slips and review operating-system scheduling requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Test Slip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a preview for a kitchen test slip. Use the title Printer Test and include checks for paper, connection, and cutter.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner preview without sending a job

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Printer
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure a printer alias. Ask for its LAN address, port, type, and remark, then show the proposed entry before any change.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Connectivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a safe connectivity-check plan for my configured printer. Validate the destination, explain expected results, and wait before running any command.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Recurring Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a weekly closing checklist print job. Preview the slip and scheduler definition, explain persistence, and require explicit approval before system changes.

output_examples.input: Prepare an immediate test slip for the kitchen printer.
output: Body preview: Check connection, paper, and cutter.
Status: Awaiting confirmation; no print was sent.

output_examples.input: Help me add a front counter printer.
output: Please provide the printer LAN address.
The default port is 9100 unless your device uses another port.
I will show the proposed alias and settings before changing configuration.

output_examples.input: Plan a closing checklist every Friday at 22:00.
output: Target: Confirm the printer alias before setup.
Persistence: The system task remains active after the web process closes.
Status: Awaiting approval before creating a scheduled task.

best_practices: Verify the printer alias, address, and port against an approved store inventory.
Preview the title and content, then obtain explicit confirmation before sending a print job.
Treat scheduler export as a persistent system change and document how to remove each task.
anti_patterns: Do not send print jobs to unverified addresses or arbitrary ports.
Do not insert untrusted title or content text into a shell command.
Do not install dependencies or create persistent tasks without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does this bundle include working printer scripts?
faq.answer: No. The audited bundle does not include the Python scripts or web files referenced by the documentation.

faq.question: Which printers are supported?
faq.answer: The documentation targets Meituan thermal printers using ESC/POS over TCP with GB18030 text. Confirm compatibility with your exact model.

faq.question: Does the printer need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The computer and printer should share a trusted local network, and the printer address must be approved.

faq.question: Can the skill schedule recurring print jobs?
faq.answer: The documentation covers daily, weekly, and monthly schedules. The required implementation files are absent from the audited bundle.

faq.question: How does the skill select a printer?
faq.answer: It documents selection by configured alias or direct IP address and port. Validate direct destinations before use.

faq.question: Is the web administration interface included?
faq.answer: No. The documentation describes a local interface, but its backend, templates, and launcher are not present in the audited bundle.
